subject: You get your games cheap. If
author: YabobK34
body: You get your games cheap. If you bought the game in Sweden you could add around £10 to that price (for the game that is... DLC seems to have the same price).

subject: he/she who hesitates. . .
author: Longy AUS
body:
Bet you wish you had've been waiting that day when they released the legendary cars & snapped them up for 400ms for the pack. Or in the case of some members bought them when they saw them, instead of thinking they would get them later😉

At the very least get the extreme hot rod, it is the best value in the game now.

subject: Way too expensive!
author: ZombieTron
body:
even in the pack it is £3 per car (on PS3)! That is just super cheeky!

The original game had 78 cars and cost £39.99 making it just 50p per car, I really don't see how they can justify the prices of the DLC packs! It's crazy!!

I was intending on buying this pack, having not bought any of the others yet as I didn't feel the vehicles were worth it, however this price point has put me off.

I really hope the Island doesn't come in at 2000+ MS points, but it's looking more and more likely that it will!

subject: Go get em!

body:

subject: Just as bad
author: Mad Wookiee11
body: It seems that Criterion has become just as bad as the other racing game developers who charge a bundle for a few extra cars.  Hopefully Criterion will lower the price of these packs at some point like Bungie did with the map packs for Halo 3.  Or maybe they are planning on making the boost specials the deal of the week and charging the leaked price then.
